scenario.title: Judgmental consultation, missed care
scenario.patient_background: Has struggled with adherence, feels judged at previous visits.

transcript.content: Your sugar levels are high again. Have you even been taking your medication properly?
I've been trying, it's just been a really hard few months.
Well if you'd just followed the plan none of this would be happening.

audio.note: This benchmark contains no real audio recordings for any case.
